owner_goal: Prioritize Inventhor Brain, existing live Design Studio UI design and real app creation after owner-reported system cleanup. Strengthen current single product rather than build a duplicate Studio or Factory.
native_situation_note: Read-only inspection 2026-11-02 saw historical module folders on disk, but installed heartbeat was from 2026-10-03; folder presence or stale heartbeat cannot attest actual live module loads. Do not reintroduce removed modules or mark clean native acceptance without fresh local Operator evidence.

independently_approved_ui_scope_required.provenance: Must be read from fresh trusted native Organizer owner-approved task, not echoed from edit snapshot

native_operator_handoff.mechanism: Existing native Organizer (actual immutable TASK_ID/PROJECT_ID/owner/lease/revision) -> existing Operator handoff and authorized native executor
native_operator_handoff.dc_budget: Conserve Desktop Commander requests; batch only genuinely necessary owner-PC read-only checks; use existing Operator for routine local execution once authorized
native_operator_handoff.additional_next_preflight: Read native exact task owner/lease/revision, active edit claims/resource locks and measured load; no local writes until atomic native preflight and Codex-owned file reconciliation

finite_steps_for_existing_operator_task: Read the canonical Organizer task and active lease and acknowledge freshest checkpoint; preserve Codex owner work and local Studio files.

Native Main/Organizer must compare active task/epoch/lease, overlapping Studio component/document/resource claims and live memory/build capacity before any operation; serialize/rebase collisions and defer capacity-limited work without dropping user request.
Compare present installed Main/Design Studio sources with Brain reviewer; do not overwrite existing DesignAiEditEngine, DesignDocumentStore, DesignPreviewInteraction or QA links.
Map an actual owner-language instruction such as making a semantic panel narrower to a stable target_semantic_id, approved operation and bounded intended component IDs.
Perform an authorized, reversible edit in existing Studio only; preserve before/after document revision and SHA256, undo snapshot and exact changed semantic IDs.
Render the exact current revision on real target viewport, capture a native action-effect witness, accessibility/keyboard/touch and layout checks plus expected localization/platform coverage.
Have existing Operator deliver the resulting authenticated evidence to the existing Brain and canonical Organizer; rerun stale/stable semantic UI gate without treating source flags as native witness.
Use same existing QA Factory to test real built app and fail->fix->retest exact new artifact; do not call preview-only result QA PASS.
Checkpoint completed/remaining/blockers/evidence to original Organizer and read it back, then mark task status truthfully.
next_check: Native Organizer current lease and active resource claims, measured CPU/memory/build load, then authorized reversible UI operation with existing Studio/Operator and QA Factory evidence.

owner_execution_policy.distinction: An owner's requested outcome is not prohibited simply because a particular existing semantic UI operation does not yet implement it. Inventhor may plan a safe extension through current five systems; unsupported operations are not permission to run arbitrary commands.
owner_execution_policy.conflict_policy: Do not overwrite Codex/other owner lease or mutable files; serialize collisions, independently allow disjoint scoped work after native atomic preflight
owner_execution_policy.budget_policy: Conserve DC. Routine authorized OS work through existing Operator. Memory/build-slot capacity deferral is temporary; no request dropped or declared DONE.
